text:
Presentation time: 35 seconds.
Introduce the team. Navel follows a fixed route in a laboratory and must select one of four social-navigation actions. Changing gaze, distance and missing detections make single observations insufficient. Our objective is an integrated temporal representation and a fair comparison of rule-based and LLM decisions.

Presentation time: 30 seconds.

Play approximately 15 seconds of the prepared montage, then deliver the closing contribution. Use captions that distinguish scripted action execution from autonomous policy selection. Integrate only adjacent intervals where both sample classifications are known. The interval uses the earlier classification for looking duration. coverage sums valid durations, looking_time sums durations classified true, gaze_fraction is looking_time divided by coverage. sustained_gaze_s is the trailing contiguous true run. Sample adjacency requires contiguous frame_sequence and dt>0 through max_gap_s. Nulls/gaps/jumps break the fitting segment. text:
Appendix for questions.

The continuous rule command/head-focus flow maintains one logical lock ID bound to a session, UID and epoch. It can acquire a sole visible track even before a ready proposal, unless no-attention/receding policy dismisses it. LOCKED permits matching target actions or YIELD; other proposals can hold. A missing target preserves the logical lock for less than two seconds. Same UID/epoch returning within hold restores it. Multiple candidates cause AMBIGUOUS. New UID is TENTATIVE_RETURN and needs guarded evidence. Policy release, timeout, long stream gap, engagement completion or terminal execution failure releases to cooldown. A hold returns effective_decision null, not a fifth action. SingleTrial first-output scoring is separate from this effective command layer.
